docs.title: 1. Register Summary Table
docs.text: Offset Name Access Default Value Description 0x00 CTRL R/W 32'h0000_0004 Global Control and Status Register 0x04 GIER R/W 32'h0000_0000 Global Interrupt Enable Register 0x10 MODE R/W 32'h0000_0000 Operation Mode Selection 0x14 SRC_ADDR R/W 32'h0000_0000 Source Data Base Address (HBM/DDR) 0x18 DST_ADDR R/W 32'h0000_0000 Destination Data Base Address (HBM/DDR) 0x1C CONFIG R/W 32'h0000_0000 Operational Parameters (Dim, Seq Len, etc.)

docs.title: 0x00: CTRL
docs.text: Bit Name Access Default Description 0 ap_start R/W 0 Start Signal: Write 1 to trigger operation. Automatically clears to 0 after start. 1 ap_done RO 0 Done Flag: Set to 1 by hardware upon completion. Cleared on read. 2 ap_idle RO 1 Idle State: 1 indicates the IP is idle and ready for new commands. 3 ap_ready RO 0 Ready Flag: 1 indicates the IP is ready to accept new data. 4:31 Reserved - 0 Reserved for future use.

docs.title: 0x10: MODE
docs.text: Bit Name Access Default Description 1:0 op_mode R/W 00 Operation Mode: 00: NOP (No Operation) 01: LOAD_LUT (Move PQ Codebook to internal BRAM) 10: LOAD_CLUSTER (Load cluster-specific data) 11: COMPUTE (Execute DPQU Core Logic) 2:31 Reserved - 0 Reserved.

docs.title: 0x14: SRC_ADDR
docs.text:
• Description: Specifies the starting physical address of input data in HBM/DDR.
  • Requirement: Address must be aligned to the AXI Data Width (e.g., 16-byte aligned for 128-bit bus).

docs.title: 0x1C: CONFIG
docs.text: Bit Name Access Default Description 15:0 seq_len R/W 0 Sequence Length of the input. 31:16 head_num R/W 0 Number of Attention Heads.

docs.title: Step A: Initialization & Check
docs.text:
1. Read 0x00 (CTRL) to ensure ap_idle is 1.
  2. Write the memory addresses to 0x14 (SRC_ADDR) and 0x18 (DST_ADDR).
  3. Configure matrix dimensions in 0x1C (CONFIG).

docs.title: Step B: Execution
docs.text:
1. Set 0x10 (MODE) to 2'b11 (COMPUTE Mode).
  2. Write 1 to 0x00 (CTRL) bit[0] (ap_start).

docs.title: Step C: Synchronization
docs.text:
1. Polling Mode: Continuously read 0x00 (CTRL) until bit[1] (ap_done) becomes 1.
  2. Interrupt Mode: Wait for the hardware interrupt signal, then enter the ISR for post-processing.

docs.title: 4. Error Handling
docs.text:
• If ap_done hangs, verify if SRC_ADDR points to a valid and authorized memory region to avoid DMA stall.
  • Ensure all mode transitions follow the prescribed sequence (e.g., LOAD_LUT must occur before COMPUTE).

docs.title: Design Specification: Input/Output Formats
docs.text: Project: DPQU (Dynamic Product Quantization Unit) Version: 1.0

docs.title: 1. Data Type Definitions
docs.text: Data Component Format Precision Range Query/Key/Value Quantized Index 8-bit Integer 0 to 255 Codebook (LUT) Floating Point FP16 / BF16 - Attention Score Fixed Point 16-bit Integer Q8.8 format

docs.title: 2.1 AXI-Stream Input (Data Feed)
docs.text:
• Bus Width: 128-bit (configured to match DMA burst)
  • TLAST Policy: Asserted at the end of each Sequence row.
  • Data Packing:
  • Byte [0]: Index 0
  • Byte [1]: Index 1
  • ...
  • Byte [15]: Index 15

docs.title: 2.2 AXI-Stream Output (Results)
docs.text:
• Bus Width: 64-bit
  • Content: Dequantized Attention Output / Intermediate Scores.

docs.title: 3. Memory Layout in HBM/DDR
docs.text: To ensure DMA efficiency, data must be stored in the following alignment:

docs.title: 3.1 PQ Indices Layout
docs.text: Address Offset Data (128-bit per Word) 0x0000 Index[0:15]  (Sequence 0) 0x0010 Index[16:31] (Sequence 0) ...

docs.title: 3.2 Codebook (LUT) Layout
docs.text:
The Codebook must be loaded into the internal BRAM before the COMPUTE mode is activated.

BRAM Depth: 256 entries

BRAM Width: 512-bit (Parallel lookup of multiple sub-vectors)

docs.title: 4. Hardware Constraints
docs.text:
Maximum Sequence Length: 4096

Maximum Head Count: 32

Unsupported Features: Variable length padding is not handled by hardware; must be pre-processed by software.

docs.title: Verible 使用說明書
docs.text: 本文件提供本專案 Verible 的標準安裝與使用流程，目標是「簡單、可重現、跨電腦可用」。

docs.title: 1. 適用情境
docs.text:
1. 在 Windows 本機安裝 Verible。
  2. 在 PowerShell、cmd、Git Bash 使用 verible-verilog-lint。
  3. 在專案中手動執行與 CI 相同的 lint 流程。

docs.title: 2. Windows 安裝（推薦）
docs.text:
在專案根目錄執行：

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install_verible_windows.ps1

安裝完成後，Verible 會放在：

C:\github\vectorAdd_8b\.tools\verible\...

docs.title: 3. 安裝後驗證
docs.text:
請用你實際要工作的終端機驗證。

PowerShell：

verible-verilog-lint --version

cmd：

verible-verilog-lint --version

Git Bash：

verible-verilog-lint --version

docs.title: 4. 專案常用 lint 指令
4.1 Git Bash / Linux
docs.text: find src/rtl src/controller -type f \( -name "*.sv" -o -name "*.v" \) -print0 | xargs -0 -r verible-verilog-lint --rules_config=.veriblelintrc

docs.title: 4.2 PowerShell（Windows）
docs.text:
Get-ChildItem src/rtl,src/controller -Recurse -File -Include *.sv,*.v |
ForEach-Object { verible-verilog-lint --rules_config=.veriblelintrc $_.FullName }

docs.title: 5.1 PowerShell 可用，但 cmd 顯示找不到指令
docs.text:
原因：cmd 不會即時刷新 PATH。

作法： 1. 關閉目前 cmd 視窗。 2. 開新 cmd 視窗後重試 verible-verilog-lint --version。

docs.title: 5.2 安裝腳本顯示已成功，但當前終端機仍找不到指令
docs.text:
原因：終端機啟動時載入的 PATH 尚未更新。

作法： 1. 關閉並重開終端機。 2. 再執行 verible-verilog-lint --version。

docs.title: 5.3 為什麼不直接用 conda 安裝 Verible
docs.text: 目前 conda-forge 沒有 win-64 的 verible 套件，Windows 需改用本專案腳本安裝。
